text.en: This Order may be cited as the Emergency (Religious Council and Citation and Kadis' Courts Act) (Amendment) Order, 1987 and shall come into commenceforce on 1st January, 1988. ment.

The Religious Council and Kadis' Courts Act (Cap. 77) is amended Repeal of in Section 48(1) by deleting the colon at the end of paragraph (a) and Proviso to substituting therefor a semi-colon and adding the word "and", and Section 48(ll(aJ. deleting the Proviso and the further Proviso to the said paragraph (a). Made this 7th day of December, 1987 at Our Istana Nurul lman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
